dedupe_keys.name: tailte eireann high value dataset buildings and building groups

description: Tailte Éireann (Ireland's land registry, valuation and mapping agency) publishes the national building polygons of the Republic of Ireland from the national mapping database, where a building is a permanent roofed construction currently or formerly intended for shelter (including buildings under construction and roofless former buildings), released as a European high value dataset together with a Building Groups layer that links physically connected buildings of a named terrace. Coverage: the whole Republic of Ireland; last modified on 2026-01-09 according to the portal, and the buildings are a Prime 2 superimposed object of the national mapping data model. Format and access: CSV, GeoJSON, KML, Excel, file geodatabase and GeoPackage downloads plus an ArcGIS REST feature service, without registration from the Tailte Éireann open data portal. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): CC BY 4.0; cost: free. Caveats: the description defines the object but the attribute list and the number of buildings were not read; polygons are map features, so building height and use are not part of the definition read. Simulation uses: national building-stock exposure for flood, wind and heat models, geometry for urban digital twins, and footprint baselines for energy-retrofit and population-exposure studies. Related catalogue records: OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap); Overture Maps buildings theme (data-overture-maps-buildings).
